integrity: All required documents and a Python 3 standalone verifier are embedded in this scientific package; independently conducted external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact count and complete run-type profile table apply to indexed linear binary words of weight three and ordered nonadjacent pair multiplicities. No claim for arbitrary weights, longer patterns or larger separations. The infinite theorem is proved by run decomposition, not by finite enumeration. Publication priority remains qualified until independent literature assessment.
title: Exact weight-three capacities of binary nonadjacent pair decks
